going_scenario: Good 4 official at 9am AEDT 4 Nov; Soft 5–6 conditional if rainfall changes
headline: Flemington Oaks Day — 24 official scratchings and revised research selections
notes: 24 official scratching withdrawals, published Wednesday 4 Nov 2026 at 5pm AEDT. Further changes possible before Thursday 7:30am AEDT scratching close.
Official rating is Good 4 from the 9am Wednesday inspection, not a guarantee of race-day going.
Tuesday 3 November model, its percentages, and historical results have not been changed; no full-field model percentages for Thursday have been recomputed.
Cavalry Girl R9 was previous rank 1 and is OUT OF FIELD. Rey Magnerio is a conditional research replacement only.
Buccleuch R3, Fiorenot R5, Cilacap and Gold Medallist R4, and Getafix R2 are officially scratched. No current pick or named active alternative is among the 24 scratchings.

selections.form: Five wins from ten and four wins at Flemington; class profile is a clear positive.
selections.risk: Despite five scratchings, a five-day backup, outside barrier, 59.5kg and limited Soft-track experience remain risks.
selections.pace: Can press forward; a reduced field may reduce pressure, but don't assume a clear lead.
selections.rationale_for_current_rank: Five R4 scratching withdrawals remove Cilacap and Gold Medallist; Sass Appeal retains quick-backup and ground risks.

selections.form: Recent Rosehill Soft 6 win; two wins from three Soft starts and form around 2000m.
selections.risk: Fiorenot and Sun Gift are scratched; Nobler benefits from a 2.5kg relative swing and Perisher's barrier is wide.
selections.pace: Needs to avoid covering extra ground; Veyepee has barrier 1.
selections.rationale_for_current_rank: Fiorenot and Sun Gift scratched. Nobler gets a 2.5kg relative weight swing from their last encounter; Veyepee remains a danger.

selections.form: Unbeaten in five, including Group 1 Spring Champion Stakes; has handled Good, Soft and Heavy ground.
selections.risk: Joely, Refuse to Curtsy and Waiheke Rose are scratched. Proxima Dea still faces barrier 19 and an unproven 2500m.
selections.pace: Expected to work for position from the wide draw; De Armas can get a much cheaper run from barrier 1.
selections.rationale_for_current_rank: Joely, Refuse to Curtsy and Waiheke Rose scratched; De Armas and Quick Finish remain strong.

selections.form: Three wins this campaign, latest a 2.5-length Caulfield win; has won on Soft ground.
selections.risk: Parcae, Fovea and Sanctuary are scratched; Scintillation's straight-course experience and pace profile remain serious threats.
selections.pace: Scintillation can be prominent from barrier 2; Sequinned draws wider and may need speed to run on.
selections.rationale_for_current_rank: Three rival scratchings; Scintillation remains the prominent Flemington-straight challenger.

selections.form: Three wins in five starts, including consecutive latest wins; barrier 2 and 53kg favour the setup.
selections.risk: BM90 class rise, no Soft-track starts, and proven rivals Alabama Fox and Bustling. Getafix is officially scratched.
selections.pace: Can sit handy with a low draw while wide-drawn rivals risk covering ground.
selections.rationale_for_current_rank: Getafix scratched, leaving Alabama Fox and Bustling among the main dangers.

selections.form: Reported fastest last 200m on the McEwen Stakes program, and straight-course experience. Conditional research replacement after Cavalry Girl's official scratching.
selections.risk: Not a model-certified leader. No wins in four documented Soft starts; straight-course lane bias, early tempo and final track rating matter.
selections.pace: Likely to be finishing from behind the leaders; requires a suitable tempo and clear straight lane.
selections.rationale_for_current_rank: Cavalry Girl scratched. Rey Magnerio's fast final 200m supports conditional promotion, but the current field has not been independently recalculated.

selections.form: Five wins from twelve Soft-track runs, proven mile form, barrier 1 and James McDonald.
selections.risk: Buccleuch now confirmed scratched. Tavi Time's wet-track record is stronger on Soft, while Good 4 requires reassessment against Encap and Enxuto.
selections.pace: Likely to receive an economical run on the rail; Just Folk may be more forward.
selections.rationale_for_current_rank: Buccleuch confirmed scratched. Tavi Time was the preferred Soft 5 alternative; current Good 4 requires reassessment.

selections.form: Two consecutive Bendigo wins, including at 1600m on Soft 6; 54.5kg and barrier 5.
selections.risk: Large-field traffic and stronger rivals; not a high-certainty race.
selections.pace: Can settle midfield to handy; Rosa Aotearoa can go forward.
selections.rationale_for_current_rank: No R6 scratching withdrawals; competitive large field remains.

selections.form: Two wins from four Soft starts and a recent 1700m victory.
selections.risk: Class rise into BM70; Bon Fete is an emergency and must be confirmed admitted.
selections.pace: Stung may go forward; Cute Girl can sit midfield and make her run.
selections.rationale_for_current_rank: Four withdrawals including two emergencies; Cute Girl still faces a class rise.
